b1-civilizaciones-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Tikal
b1-civilizaciones-01.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg have watched a documentary about the Maya, and she asks what happened to Tikal.
b1-civilizaciones-01.prompt: Tell Meg what happened to Tikal.
cues: Say that it was abandoned, and how
b1-civilizaciones-01.target: Tikal fue abandonada poco a poco.
b1-civilizaciones-01.english: Tikal was abandoned little by little.
b1-civilizaciones-01.canDo: I can say what was built, abandoned or deciphered, using ser + participle.

b1-civilizaciones-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Tenochtitlan
b1-civilizaciones-02.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have visited a museum about the Mexica, and he asks how the city grew.
b1-civilizaciones-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what the Mexica did while Tenochtitlan was growing.
cues: Say what was happening to the city
b1-civilizaciones-02.target: Mientras la ciudad crecía, los mexicas construyeron calzadas y canales.
b1-civilizaciones-02.english: While the city was growing, the Mexica built causeways and canals.
b1-civilizaciones-02.canDo: I can say what happened and what was going on, using the preterite and the imperfect.

b1-civilizaciones-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Inca empire
b1-civilizaciones-03.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg have read a book about the Inca, and she asks what you remember about their empire.
b1-civilizaciones-03.prompt: Tell Meg something about the Inca empire and its capital.
cues: Say that the Incas had an empire
Say whose capital it was, using cuya
b1-civilizaciones-03.target: Los incas tenían un imperio cuya capital era Cuzco.
b1-civilizaciones-03.english: The Incas had an empire whose capital was Cuzco.
b1-civilizaciones-03.canDo: I can say whose something was or is, using cuyo, cuya, cuyos and cuyas.

b1-civilizaciones-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Maya calendar
b1-civilizaciones-04.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have gone to a class about the Maya, and he asks what was special about their calendar.
b1-civilizaciones-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what the specialists say about the Maya calendar.
cues: Say that it was one of the best of its time
b1-civilizaciones-04.target: Según los especialistas, el calendario maya fue uno de los más precisos de su época.
b1-civilizaciones-04.english: According to the specialists, the Maya calendar was one of the most precise of its time.
b1-civilizaciones-04.canDo: I can form superlatives with el más and uno de los más.

b1-civilizaciones-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Indigenous languages
b1-civilizaciones-05.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg have watched a documentary about indigenous languages today, and she asks what has changed for children at school.
b1-civilizaciones-05.prompt: Tell Meg how things were before and what has changed.
cues: Say that children could not study in their language before
Say that several countries have created bilingual programmes
b1-civilizaciones-05.target: Antes muchos niños indígenas no podían estudiar en su lengua, pero varios países han creado programas bilingües.
b1-civilizaciones-05.english: Before, many indigenous children could not study in their language, but several countries have created bilingual programmes.
b1-civilizaciones-05.canDo: I can use the imperfect and the present perfect to describe change over time.

b1-civilizaciones-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Maya, Mexica and Inca
b1-civilizaciones-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have just come out of a museum about the Maya, the Mexica and the Inca, and he asks what you liked most.
b1-civilizaciones-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos two things you learned about the Maya.
cues: Say that Maya glyphs were deciphered, and when
Say what was special about the Maya calendar
b1-civilizaciones-consolidation.target: Los glifos mayas fueron descifrados en el siglo XX, y el calendario maya fue uno de los más precisos de su época.
b1-civilizaciones-consolidation.english: The Maya glyphs were deciphered in the twentieth century, and the Maya calendar was one of the most precise of its time.
b1-civilizaciones-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about the Maya, the Mexica and the Inca and what they left.
